---
title: "Keys"
subtitle: "Two kinds: ⌘⇧ and a letter shows a panel; ⌘ and a letter opens a page, or does one thing."
---

[⌘]{.kbd} on macOS, [Ctrl]{.kbd} elsewhere.

## Panels {.i-app-window}

Hold [⇧]{.kbd} with [⌘]{.kbd}, and the letter shows or hides a panel
beside the chat. The letter is the panel's first.

| | |
|---|---|
| [⌘⇧F]{.kbd} | [files](files.qmd) |
| [⌘⇧O]{.kbd} | [outline](outline.qmd) |
| [⌘⇧S]{.kbd} | [shell terminal](shell.qmd) |
| [⌘⇧A]{.kbd} | [agent terminal](agent.qmd) |
| [⌘⇧G]{.kbd} | git's [Changes](files.qmd#git) sheet |

: {.table-keys tbl-colwidths="[38,62]"}

## Pages {.i-keyboard}

[⌘]{.kbd} and a letter opens a page or a sheet over the window.

| | |
|---|---|
| [⌘K]{.kbd} | search every session |
| [⌘N]{.kbd} | new session |
| [⌘T]{.kbd} | new session in this project |
| [⌘O]{.kbd} | choose a folder |
| [⌘L]{.kbd} | All Sessions |
| [⌘E]{.kbd} | Agents |
| [⌘,]{.kbd} | Settings |

: {.table-keys tbl-colwidths="[38,62]"}

The rest of [⌘]{.kbd} each does one thing where you are.

| | |
|---|---|
| [⌘F]{.kbd} · [⌘G]{.kbd} | find in this chat, and the next hit; [⌘⇧G]{.kbd} is the previous while the find bar is open |
| [⌘↩]{.kbd} | send, or commit in the Changes sheet |
| [⌘P]{.kbd} | push, in the Changes sheet |
| [⌘S]{.kbd} | save the file |
| [⌘B]{.kbd} | sidebar |
| [⌘1]{.kbd} to [⌘9]{.kbd} | tabs |
| [⌘W]{.kbd} · [⌘⇧T]{.kbd} | close a tab, reopen the last |
| [⌘⇧N]{.kbd} | new branch |
| [⌘R]{.kbd} | refresh |
| [Esc]{.kbd} | stop, or close what is open |

: {.table-keys tbl-colwidths="[38,62]"}

In the terminal, [⌘T]{.kbd} opens a tab, [⌘W]{.kbd} closes it and
[⌘K]{.kbd} clears the screen.
